# API reference: SCNodeClass

<!-- Generated by `make docs-api` from config/crd/bases; do not edit. -->

Every field of the `SCNodeClass` custom resource, as the API server accepts it
(generated from the CRD). One SCNodeClass holds the node definition shared by
every vendor and a typed block per vendor under `spec.vendors`; the
selector and ranking fields of `spec.selections` are those of
sc-karpenter-nodepool (module sc-keeper-go, package selection/api). The design
behind the fields is in the [decision records](../explanation/DECISIONS.md)
(ADR-014, ADR-018 and ADR-020).

Units: memory and disk sizes are Kubernetes quantities (`64Gi`) unless a field
name says otherwise, prices are USD per hour (decimal strings such as
`"0.40"`), durations are strings such as `24h`, every other number is a
plain number.

## Resource

| | |
|---|---|
| apiVersion | `scarpenter.sparecores.com/v1alpha1` |
| kind | `SCNodeClass` |
| scope | Cluster |
| resource | `scnodeclasses` |
| subresources | `status` |
| printer columns | Vendors, Ready, Age |

SCNodeClass is the node definition SCarpenter launches nodes from: shared settings plus a block per vendor.

## spec

### `spec`

SCNodeClassSpec is the node definition shared by every vendor, plus a typed block per vendor (ADR-014). Which vendor a NodeClaim uses is chosen by the NodePool's scarpenter.sparecores.com/vendor requirement.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `billing` | [object](#specbilling) |  | billing opts in to keeping nodes until the end of the billing period they have already paid for (ADR-024). Changing it is not drift. |
| `bootstrap` | [object](#specbootstrap) |  | bootstrap holds the opt-in changes to the node's boot configuration that a vendor's driver can contribute (plan 14 A7). |
| `butane` | [object](#specbutane) |  | butane references extra Butane configuration merged into every node's Ignition. |
| `catalog` | [object](#speccatalog) |  | catalog configures the instance type catalog built from Keeper. |
| `flatcar` (required) | [object](#specflatcar) |  | flatcar selects the Flatcar Container Linux release nodes boot. |
| `kubelet` | [object](#speckubelet) | `{}` | kubelet configures the kubelet and the node capacity the scheduler assumes. |
| `kubernetes` (required) | [object](#speckubernetes) |  | kubernetes selects the Kubernetes release (a sysext-bakery release) nodes run. |
| `metrics` | map of [object](#specmetrics) |  | metrics define benchmark metric labels (metric-&lt;name&gt;, -pct and -per-usd) on instance types and offerings. |
| `network` (required) | [object](#specnetwork) |  | network is the node bootstrap network template (how nodes reach the control plane). |
| `networking` | [object](#specnetworking) | `{}` | networking is the generic network setting, identical in meaning on every vendor; vendor blocks may override it. |
| `poweroffAfter` | string |  | poweroffAfter powers a node off after this long: a fail-safe against instances that outlive their NodeClaim. Pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(s\|m\|h))+$`. |
| `pricing` | [object](#specpricing) | `{}` | pricing configures how offerings are priced. |
| `profiles` | [object](#specprofiles) | `{}` | profiles are named, explicit, vendor-native setups that workloads pick by name through labels. |
| `selections` | map of [object](#specselections) |  | selections define selection profiles: sc-karpenter-nodepool's selector and ranking, evaluated on every catalog refresh. Instance types carry the label selection=&lt;name&gt; for each profile they belong to. |
| `sysexts` | array of [object](#specsysexts) |  | sysexts lists extra systemd sysexts installed on every node. At most 16 items. |
| `tags` | map of string values |  | tags are added to every vendor resource SCarpenter creates (tags or labels, as the vendor calls them). Rule: tag keys in the scarpenter.sparecores.com domain are reserved (`self.all(k, !k.startsWith('scarpenter.sparecores.com/'))`). |
| `vendors` (required) | [object](#specvendors) |  | vendors has one block per vendor; a vendor is enabled for this SCNodeClass by having a block. |

### `spec.billing`

billing opts in to keeping nodes until the end of the billing period they have already paid for (ADR-024). Changing it is not drift.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `margin` | string | `"3m"` | margin is how long before the end of the period the node is released: it has to cover the drain, the termination finalizer, the vendor's delete and clock skew. At least 90 s; a vendor with a slow delete widens it. Pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(s\|m\|h))+$`. Rule: margin must be at least 90s (`duration(self) >= duration('90s')`). |
| `maxRetainedNodes` | integer (int32) |  | maxRetainedNodes is an optional safety valve: it trims the held empty nodes of the NodeClass down to this number, nearest deadline first. Unset means no cap; a launch blocked by a NodePool limit or a vendor quota releases held empty nodes first either way. Minimum 1. |
| `minPeriod` | string | `"10m"` | minPeriod is the shortest billing increment that is held to its end: shorter increments are not worth a hold. It does not gate the hold of a minimum (a minimum has its own 2 minute floor). Pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(s\|m\|h))+$`. Rule: minPeriod must be at least 1m (`duration(self) >= duration('1m')`). |
| `retainUntilPeriodEnd` | boolean | `false` | retainUntilPeriodEnd keeps a node a vendor bills by the started period (an hour on hcloud, UpCloud, Vultr), or by a minimum and then per second (Alibaba), until its paid period is about to end, so that Karpenter reuses it for the next job, and deletes it before the next charge starts. Off by default. |

### `spec.bootstrap`

bootstrap holds the opt-in changes to the node's boot configuration that a vendor's driver can contribute (plan 14 A7).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hardening` | array of string |  | hardening lists the opt-in hardenings of the boot configuration. Off by default: they change what Pods on the node can reach. A vendor whose driver offers none of them (AWS) ignores the list and says so in an Event. One of `metadata-from-pods`. At most 8 items. |

### `spec.catalog`

catalog configures the instance type catalog built from Keeper.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpuFlagLabels` | array of string |  | cpuFlagLabels are the CPU flags that get a cpu-flag-&lt;flag&gt; label on instance types. The set is closed: the labels are registered with Karpenter core at start-up, so only this curated list of flags useful for workload selection (names as in Keeper's cpu_flags, Linux /proc/cpuinfo spelling) is accepted. Defaults to avx2, avx512f, amx_tile and sha_ni. One of `avx`, `avx2`, `avx512f`, `avx512bw`, `avx512vl`, `avx512dq`, `avx512cd`, `avx512_vnni`, `avx512_bf16`, `avx512_fp16`, `avx512vbmi`, `avx512ifma`, `avx_vnni`, `amx_tile`, `amx_bf16`, `amx_int8`, `sha_ni`, `aes`, `vaes`, `gfni`, `pclmulqdq`, `bmi2`, `fma`, `sse4_2`, `asimd`, `sve`, `sve2`, `sha2`, `sha3`. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.kubelet`

kubelet configures the kubelet and the node capacity the scheduler assumes.

Validation: systemReserved keys must be cpu, memory, ephemeral-storage or pid (`!has(self.systemReserved) \|\| self.systemReserved.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage', 'pid'])`).

Validation: kubeReserved keys must be cpu, memory, ephemeral-storage or pid (`!has(self.kubeReserved) \|\| self.kubeReserved.all(k, k in ['cpu', 'memory', 'ephemeral-storage', 'pid'])`).

Validation: evictionHard keys must be eviction signals (`!has(self.evictionHard) \|\| self.evictionHard.all(k, k in ['memory.available', 'nodefs.available', 'nodefs.inodesFree', 'imagefs.available', 'imagefs.inodesFree', 'pid.available'])`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evictionHard` | map of string values |  | evictionHard thresholds, e.g. memory.available: 100Mi. |
| `kubeReserved` | map of string values |  | kubeReserved overrides the computed resources reserved for Kubernetes daemons. |
| `maxPods` | integer (int32) | `110` | maxPods is the maximum number of Pods per node. Minimum 1. Maximum 1000. |
| `systemReserved` | map of string values |  | systemReserved resources for system daemons. |
| `vmMemoryOverheadPercent` | number | `7.5` | vmMemoryOverheadPercent is the share of the catalog memory a VM does not offer to the guest, subtracted from the instance type's capacity. Minimum 0. Maximum 50. |

### `spec.metrics.*`

Metric defines a benchmark metric: a benchmark or a workload profile, optionally normalised per vCPU. Exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile is set.

Validation: set exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile (`has(self.benchmark) != has(self.workloadProfile)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `benchmark` | [object](#specmetricsbenchmark) |  | benchmark identifies a Spare Cores benchmark (id and config). |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize is applied to the score before the labels are computed. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`. |
| `scale` | integer (int32) | `1` | scale multiplies the score before it is rounded to the integer label value, to keep precision (e.g. 100). Minimum 1. Maximum 1e+06. |
| `workloadProfile` | string |  | workloadProfile is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |

### `spec.metrics.*.benchmark`

benchmark identifies a Spare Cores benchmark (id and config).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |

### `spec.network`

network is the node bootstrap network template (how nodes reach the control plane).

Validation: network.tailscale is required with template tailscale and invalid otherwise (`self.template == 'tailscale' ? has(self.tailscale) : !has(self.tailscale)`).

Validation: network.custom is required with template custom and invalid otherwise (`self.template == 'custom' ? has(self.custom) : !has(self.custom)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `custom` | [object](#specnetworkcustom) |  | custom configures the custom template. |
| `tailscale` | [object](#specnetworktailscale) |  | tailscale configures the tailscale template. |
| `template` (required) | string |  | template: tailscale joins nodes through a tailnet, direct has nodes reach the API server directly, custom renders your own Butane template. One of `tailscale`, `direct`, `custom`. |

### `spec.networking`

networking is the generic network setting, identical in meaning on every vendor; vendor blocks may override it.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound lists the allowed inbound traffic. Without rules everything inbound is denied (a deny firewall is attached where the vendor default is open). |
| `isolation` | string | `"run"` | isolation decides who may reach a node privately: none (no other node: the strictest, only inbound rules apply; it does not mean "not isolated"), the nodes of the SCNodeClass, or only the nodes of the same run (placement group run key; without a run key the nodes of the SCNodeClass are one run). One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean | `true` | publicIPv4 gives nodes a public IPv4 address. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean | `false` | publicIPv6 gives nodes a public IPv6 address. |

### `spec.networking.inbound`

inbound lists the allowed inbound traffic. Without rules everything inbound is denied (a deny firewall is attached where the vendor default is open).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*`

StorageProfile is a named storage setup, in the vendor's own terms, for each vendor it applies to. On a vendor without a block the profile does not exist.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alicloud` | [object](#specprofilesstoragealicloud) |  | Storage is the Alibaba Cloud storage block: the system disk and the extra data disks created with the instance. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the alicloud block of a storage profile (layer 3). |
| `aws` | [object](#specprofilesstorageaws) |  | Storage is the AWS storage block: the settings of the root volume, the extra EBS volumes and the instance-local disks. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the AWS block of a storage profile (layer 3). |
| `fake` | [object](#specprofilesstoragefake) |  | Storage is the fake storage block (vendor block and storage profile). |
| `hcloud` | [object](#specprofilesstoragehcloud) |  | Storage is the Hetzner storage block: data volumes. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the hcloud block of a storage profile (layer 3). There is no root and no local storage: the root disk is the server type's, and Hetzner servers have no local disks. |
| `ovh` | [object](#specprofilesstorageovh) |  | Storage is the OVH storage block: the root disk and the extra Cinder volumes. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the OVH block of a storage profile (layer 3). |
| `qemu` | [object](#specprofilesstorageqemu) |  | Storage is the qemu storage block (vendor block and storage profile). |
| `vultr` | object (free-form) |  | Storage is the Vultr block of a storage profile. It is empty in v1: the plan's disk is the root disk and extra block storage volumes are deferred, so a storage profile with a vultr block makes every Vultr offering unavailable with a reason. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.alicloud`

Storage is the Alibaba Cloud storage block: the system disk and the extra data disks created with the instance. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the alicloud block of a storage profile (layer 3).

Validation: localStorage policy must be ignore: local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (`!has(self.localStorage) \|\| self.localStorage.policy == 'ignore'`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specprofilesstoragealiclouddata) |  | data lists extra disks created with the instance (all deleted with it). At most 16 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specprofilesstoragealicloudlocalstorage) |  | localStorage is accepted so that a profile written for a vendor with local disks is not pruned silently, but local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (the i and d families are deferred): only the policy ignore is accepted, any other is refused when the object is applied. |
| `root` | [object](#specprofilesstoragealicloudroot) |  | root configures the system disk. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.alicloud.data[]`

DataDisk is an extra disk: ECS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: performanceLevel is only valid for cloud_essd (`!has(self.performanceLevel) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_essd'`).

Validation: provisionedIops and burstingEnabled are only valid for cloud_auto (`(!has(self.provisionedIops) && !has(self.burstingEnabled)) \|\| (has(self.category) && self.category == 'cloud_auto')`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burstingEnabled` | boolean |  | burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk. |
| `category` | string |  | category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd. One of `cloud_essd`, `cloud_auto`, `cloud_essd_entry`, `cloud_efficiency`, `cloud_ssd`. |
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `performanceLevel` | string |  | performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0. One of `PL0`, `PL1`, `PL2`, `PL3`. |
| `provisionedIops` | integer (int64) |  | provisionedIops of a cloud_auto disk. Minimum 0. Maximum 50000. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk, e.g. 100Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.alicloud.localStorage`

localStorage is accepted so that a profile written for a vendor with local disks is not pruned silently, but local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (the i and d families are deferred): only the policy ignore is accepted, any other is refused when the object is applied.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.alicloud.root`

root configures the system disk.

Validation: performanceLevel is only valid for cloud_essd (`!has(self.performanceLevel) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_essd'`).

Validation: provisionedIops and burstingEnabled are only valid for cloud_auto (`(!has(self.provisionedIops) && !has(self.burstingEnabled)) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_auto'`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burstingEnabled` | boolean |  | burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk. |
| `category` | string |  | category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd. One of `cloud_essd`, `cloud_auto`, `cloud_essd_entry`, `cloud_efficiency`, `cloud_ssd`. |
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false: ECS refuses encrypted system disks in some zones (Singapore zone A, Hong Kong zone D), and true takes those zones out of the offerings. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption; the account's default service key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `performanceLevel` | string |  | performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0. One of `PL0`, `PL1`, `PL2`, `PL3`. |
| `provisionedIops` | integer (int64) |  | provisionedIops of a cloud_auto disk. Minimum 0. Maximum 50000. |
| `size` | integer or string |  | size of the disk, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi for the system disk. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws`

Storage is the AWS storage block: the settings of the root volume, the extra EBS volumes and the instance-local disks. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the AWS block of a storage profile (layer 3).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specprofilesstorageawsdata) |  | data lists extra EBS volumes created with the instance. At most 8 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specprofilesstorageawslocalstorage) |  | localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them. |
| `root` | [object](#specprofilesstorageawsroot) |  | root configures the root EBS volume. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.data[]`

DataVolume is an extra EBS volume: EBS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` (required) | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the volume, e.g. 500Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.localStorage`

localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.aws.root`

root configures the root EBS volume.

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!has(self.volumeType) \|\| !(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption; the account's default EBS key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the root volume, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. Built-in default gp3. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

DataDisk is a fake extra disk.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

root configures the root disk.

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.hcloud`

Storage is the Hetzner storage block: data volumes. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the hcloud block of a storage profile (layer 3). There is no root and no local storage: the root disk is the server type's, and Hetzner servers have no local disks.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specprofilesstoragehclouddata) |  | data lists data volumes: each is created in the location before the server and attached to it. Volumes outlive servers, so SCarpenter deletes them once no server uses them. At most 16 items. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.hcloud.data[]`

DataVolume is a data volume: its size plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path). The first-boot unit formats and mounts it by its stable /dev/disk/by-id link.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the volume, e.g. 100Gi. Hetzner counts GB: the size is rounded up to whole GB and is 10 GB to 10 TB. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.ovh`

Storage is the OVH storage block: the root disk and the extra Cinder volumes. It is the vendor block's storage (layer 2) and the OVH block of a storage profile (layer 3).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specprofilesstorageovhdata) |  | data lists extra Cinder volumes created with the instance (at most 8). At most 8 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specprofilesstorageovhlocalstorage) |  | localStorage is not supported on OVH: a profile that asks for it is unsupported for every type, and the vendor block is invalid with it. |
| `root` | [object](#specprofilesstorageovhroot) |  | root selects the root disk: absent, the flavor's local NVMe disk. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.ovh.data[]`

DataVolume is an extra Cinder volume: its type and size plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the volume, 10Gi to 12000Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the Cinder volume type. One of `classic`, `high-speed`, `high-speed-gen2`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.ovh.localStorage`

localStorage is not supported on OVH: a profile that asks for it is unsupported for every type, and the vendor block is invalid with it.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.ovh.root`

root selects the root disk: absent, the flavor's local NVMe disk.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

### `spec.profiles.storage.*.ovh.root.bootFromVolume`

bootFromVolume boots from a Cinder volume created from the image; the flavor's disk is then unused. The only way to choose the root size and type.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the volume, 10Gi to 12000Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the Cinder volume type. One of `classic`, `high-speed`, `high-speed-gen2`. |

### `spec.selections.*`

Selection is a selection profile: sc-karpenter-nodepool's selector and ranking, verbatim. At least one of them is set.

Validation: set selector, ranking or both (`has(self.selector) \|\| has(self.ranking)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ranking` | [object](#specselectionsranking) |  | ranking keeps the best families of the candidates. |
| `selector` | [object](#specselectionsselector) |  | selector filters instance types by Spare Cores data. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking`

ranking keeps the best families of the candidates.

Validation: ranking needs band or families.max (`has(self.band) \|\| (has(self.families) && has(self.families.max))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `band` | [object](#specselectionsrankingband) |  | band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's. |
| `families` | [object](#specselectionsrankingfamilies) |  | families bounds the number of kept families. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize is applied to the score before the objective. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`. |
| `objective` | string | `"Score"` | objective is what the ranking optimises. One of `Score`, `ScorePerPrice`, `Price`. |
| `score` (required) | [object](#specselectionsrankingscore) |  | score is what to rank by. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.band`

band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `withinPercent` (required) | number |  | withinPercent: keep families within this percentage of the best. Minimum 0. Maximum 100. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.families`

families bounds the number of kept families.

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | integer (int32) |  | max keeps at most this many families, even if more are inside the band. Minimum 1. |
| `min` | integer (int32) | `1` | min widens the band until at least this many families are kept (the capacity floor). Minimum 1. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.score`

score is what to rank by.

Validation: set exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile (`has(self.benchmark) != has(self.workloadProfile)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `benchmark` | [object](#specselectionsrankingscorebenchmark) |  | BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark. |
| `workloadProfile` | string |  | WorkloadProfileName is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |

### `spec.selections.*.ranking.score.benchmark`

BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector`

selector filters instance types by Spare Cores data.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accelerator` | [object](#specselectionsselectoraccelerator) |  | AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators"). |
| `architectures` | array of string |  | architectures restricts the CPU architecture; intersected with a kubernetes.io/arch requirement of the template. One of `amd64`, `arm64`. At most 2 items. |
| `benchmarks` | array of [object](#specselectionsselectorbenchmarks) |  | benchmarks are filters on benchmark scores; entries are AND-ed. At most 32 items. |
| `cpu` | [object](#specselectionsselectorcpu) |  | CPUSelector selects on CPU facts. |
| `families` | [object](#specselectionsselectorfamilies) |  | families include/exclude globs on the Spare Cores family string. |
| `instanceTypes` | [object](#specselectionsselectorinstancetypes) |  | instanceTypes include/exclude globs on the instance type name (server.api_reference). |
| `memory` | [object](#specselectionsselectormemory) |  | MemorySelector selects on memory size, in GiB. |
| `network` | [object](#specselectionsselectornetwork) |  | NetworkSelector selects on network bandwidth. Setting a field excludes every type without a value. |
| `price` | [object](#specselectionsselectorprice) |  | PriceSelector selects on the hourly price in USD. |
| `storage` | [object](#specselectionsselectorstorage) |  | StorageSelector selects on instance-local storage. |
| `unbenchmarked` | string | `"Exclude"` | unbenchmarked decides what happens to candidates that lack a score needed by a benchmark filter, workload profile or the ranking score. One of `Exclude`, `IncludeIfFamilyQualifies`, `Include`. |

| `workloadProfiles` | array of [object](#specselectionsselectorworkloadprofiles) |  | workloadProfiles are filters on the compound workload benchmarks; entries are AND-ed with the benchmarks. At most 8 items. |

### `spec.selections.*.selector.benchmarks[]`

BenchmarkFilter is one filter on a benchmark score.

| `min` | number |  | min is an inclusive lower bound on the (normalised) score, for higher-is-better benchmarks. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize selects the score normalisation. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`, `PerPrice`. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud`

alicloud configures Alibaba Cloud (ECS) nodes.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `imageOwner` | string |  | imageOwner is the account UID that owns the Flatcar images. Empty means the account of the controller's credentials (images created there with ImportImage or CopyImage, the supported path of v1); set it for images another account shares or publishes. Pattern `^([0-9]{1,20})?$`. |
| `internetChargeType` | string |  | internetChargeType is how the public bandwidth is billed. Built-in default PayByTraffic. PayByBandwidth makes the offering's price incomplete. One of `PayByTraffic`, `PayByBandwidth`. |
| `internetMaxBandwidthOut` | integer (int32) |  | internetMaxBandwidthOut is the peak public outbound bandwidth in Mbit/s; 0 means no public IPv4 address (the same as networking.publicIPv4: false). Built-in default 100. Minimum 0. Maximum 100. |
| `metadataOptions` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudmetadataoptions) |  | metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: httpTokens optional, because Ignition's aliyun provider reads the user data without a token (see the reference for the consequence and the hardening that closes it). |
| `networking` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudnetworking) |  | networking overrides the generic spec.networking for Alibaba Cloud. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions is the allow-list of Alibaba Cloud region IDs (ap-southeast-1, eu-central-1); empty means every region the account can use. At most 64 items. |
| `resourceGroupId` | string |  | resourceGroupId is the enterprise resource group of the resources created for the nodes. Empty means the account's default group. At most 64 characters. |
| `resources` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresources) |  | resources says how the Alibaba Cloud resources a node depends on are provided. |
| `storage` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudstorage) |  | storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (a cloud_essd PL0 system disk of 64 GiB, not encrypted; no data disks). |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.metadataOptions`

metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: httpTokens optional, because Ignition's aliyun provider reads the user data without a token (see the reference for the consequence and the hardening that closes it).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `httpTokens` | string |  | httpTokens is the token requirement of the metadata service. Only optional is accepted: required (the hardened mode, IMDSv2 only) makes ECS answer 403 to Ignition's aliyun provider, which reads the user data without a token, so the nodes would not boot. Built-in default optional. One of `optional`. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.networking`

networking overrides the generic spec.networking for Alibaba Cloud.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound. |
| `isolation` | string |  | isolation overrides spec.networking.isolation. One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean |  | publicIPv4 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv4. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean |  | publicIPv6 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv6. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.networking.inbound`

inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specvendorsalicloudnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources`

resources says how the Alibaba Cloud resources a node depends on are provided.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deploymentSets` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsets) |  | deploymentSets nodes are launched into (see the placement profiles). |
| `images` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesimages) |  | images brings the Flatcar boot images with the one selector of every resource kind: explicit image IDs per region, a name pattern, tags or native filters. Optional: without it the driver finds the pinned release by the name convention Flatcar-&lt;channel&gt;-&lt;version&gt;-&lt;arch&gt; among the images of imageOwner. Whatever the lookup, the image's name or tags must say the pinned channel and version, or the region's images are not ready. Images take use only. |
| `securityGroups` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcessecuritygroups) |  | securityGroups attached to nodes (normal groups in the vSwitches' VPC). |
| `subnets` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcessubnets) |  | subnets are the vSwitches nodes are launched into (with their VPC). |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets`

deploymentSets nodes are launched into (see the placement profiles).

Validation: at most one of use, create and forbid may be set (`(has(self.use) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.create) ? 1 : 0) + ((has(self.forbid) && self.forbid) ? 1 : 0) <= 1`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetscreate) |  | create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle. |
| `forbid` | boolean |  | forbid opts the kind out of auto-creation: offerings that need it are unavailable unless the vendor's default resource exists. |
| `use` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetsuse) |  | use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.create`

create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifecycle` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetscreatelifecycle) |  | lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3). |
| `timing` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetscreatetiming) |  | timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.create.lifecycle`

lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3).

Validation: ttl is only valid with policy idleTTL (`self.policy == 'idleTTL' \|\| !has(self.ttl)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy is perUse, idleTTL or retain. One of `perUse`, `idleTTL`, `retain`. |
| `ttl` | string |  | ttl is how long an unused resource is kept (policy idleTTL). Default 24h, or the controller's --resource-default-ttl. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.create.timing`

timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand.

Validation: regions is required with mode preCreate and invalid otherwise (`self.mode == 'preCreate' ? has(self.regions) : !has(self.regions)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `"onDemand"` | mode: onDemand creates the resource when the first launch needs it; preCreate creates it in the listed regions right away and keeps it. One of `onDemand`, `preCreate`. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions are the regions to create the resource in (mode preCreate). At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.use`

use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted.

Validation: set at least one of ids, name, tags, match, filters and expression: an empty use would select every resource (`has(self.ids) \|\| has(self.name) \|\| has(self.tags) \|\| has(self.match) \|\| has(self.filters) \|\| has(self.expression)`).

Validation: orderBy is only valid with select newest or oldest (`!has(self.orderBy) \|\| (has(self.select) && (self.select == 'newest' \|\| self.select == 'oldest'))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string |  | expression is a query in the vendor's own language, where it has one. At most 4096 characters. |
| `filters` | array of [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetsusefilters) |  | filters are the vendor's own filters for the kind, passed through: name is the vendor's filter or parameter name, values are ORed. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. |
| `ids` | map of array values |  | ids lists vendor IDs per region (the vendor's region name). The key "*" applies to every region in scope (a resource that is global at the vendor, the same ID in every region); a region key adds to it. With other fields the IDs are ANDed with them. Rule: ids keys are a region name or * (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 64)`). |
| `match` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesdeploymentsetsusematch) |  | match holds the portable attributes, with one spelling on every vendor. |
| `name` | string |  | name is a glob on the kind's name field: * is any run of characters, ? one character, \ escapes them; exact without wildcards. At most 255 characters. |
| `orderBy` | string |  | orderBy is what newest and oldest order by: created, name or label:&lt;key&gt;. At most 255 characters. Rule: orderBy is created, name or label:<key> (`self == 'created' \|\| self == 'name' \|\| (self.startsWith('label:') && self.size() > 6)`). |
| `select` | string |  | select says how many of the matches are used. Without it the kind's default applies (the driver's capability declaration). One of `exactlyOne`, `all`, `newest`, `oldest`. |
| `tags` | map of string values |  | tags are tags (labels, where the vendor has no tags) that must all be on the resource with the given value; the value "*" means the key exists. Rule: tag keys are 1 to 255 characters and values at most 255 (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 255 && self[k].size() <= 255)`). |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.use.filters[]`

ResourceFilter is one of the vendor's own filters.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | string |  | name is the vendor's own filter or parameter name. At most 255 characters. |
| `values` (required) | array of string |  | values are ORed. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 255 characters. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.deploymentSets.use.match`

match holds the portable attributes, with one spelling on every vendor.

Validation: match sets no attribute (`has(self.architecture) \|\| has(self.owner) \|\| has(self.state) \|\| has(self.includeDeprecated) \|\| has(self.createdAfter) \|\| has(self.createdBefore) \|\| has(self.description) \|\| has(self.zone) \|\| has(self.network) \|\| has(self.cidr) \|\| has(self.within)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `architecture` | array of string |  | architecture is the CPU architecture of an image. One of `amd64`, `arm64`. At least 1 items. At most 2 items. |
| `cidr` | string |  | cidr is a range the resource's range must equal. At most 255 characters. Rule: cidr must be a CIDR (`isCIDR(self)`). |
| `createdAfter` | string (date-time) |  | createdAfter and createdBefore bound the creation time (RFC 3339), on kinds that have one. |
| `createdBefore` | string (date-time) |  |  |
| `description` | string |  | description is a glob on the description field. At most 255 characters. |
| `includeDeprecated` | boolean |  | includeDeprecated includes images the vendor marked deprecated. |
| `network` | array of string |  | network lists the network IDs a subnet or security group belongs to. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 255 characters. |
| `owner` | array of string |  | owner is whose resources to look at: self, an account or project ID, or the vendor's public alias. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 255 characters. |
| `state` | array of string |  | state is the vendor's state, normalised. Default [available] for every kind that has a state. One of `available`, `pending`, `failed`. At least 1 items. At most 3 items. |
| `within` | string |  | within is a range the resource's range must lie inside. At most 255 characters. Rule: within must be a CIDR (`isCIDR(self)`). |
| `zone` | array of string |  | zone lists the vendor's zone IDs of a zonal resource. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 255 characters. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.images`

images brings the Flatcar boot images with the one selector of every resource kind: explicit image IDs per region, a name pattern, tags or native filters. Optional: without it the driver finds the pinned release by the name convention Flatcar-&lt;channel&gt;-&lt;version&gt;-&lt;arch&gt; among the images of imageOwner. Whatever the lookup, the image's name or tags must say the pinned channel and version, or the region's images are not ready. Images take use only.

Validation: images accepts use only: it has no create and no forbid (`has(self.use) && !has(self.create) && !(has(self.forbid) && self.forbid)`).

Validation: images cannot use select all: a launch needs one image (`!has(self.use) \|\| !has(self.use.select) \|\| self.use.select != 'all'`).

Validation: at most one of use, create and forbid may be set (`(has(self.use) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.create) ? 1 : 0) + ((has(self.forbid) && self.forbid) ? 1 : 0) <= 1`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesimagescreate) |  | create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle. |
| `forbid` | boolean |  | forbid opts the kind out of auto-creation: offerings that need it are unavailable unless the vendor's default resource exists. |
| `use` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudresourcesimagesuse) |  | use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.resources.images.create`

create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.storage`

storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (a cloud_essd PL0 system disk of 64 GiB, not encrypted; no data disks).

Validation: localStorage policy must be ignore: local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (`!has(self.localStorage) \|\| self.localStorage.policy == 'ignore'`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specvendorsalicloudstoragedata) |  | data lists extra disks created with the instance (all deleted with it). At most 16 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudstoragelocalstorage) |  | localStorage is accepted so that a profile written for a vendor with local disks is not pruned silently, but local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (the i and d families are deferred): only the policy ignore is accepted, any other is refused when the object is applied. |
| `root` | [object](#specvendorsalicloudstorageroot) |  | root configures the system disk. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.storage.data[]`

DataDisk is an extra disk: ECS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: performanceLevel is only valid for cloud_essd (`!has(self.performanceLevel) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_essd'`).

Validation: provisionedIops and burstingEnabled are only valid for cloud_auto (`(!has(self.provisionedIops) && !has(self.burstingEnabled)) \|\| (has(self.category) && self.category == 'cloud_auto')`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burstingEnabled` | boolean |  | burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk. |
| `category` | string |  | category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd. One of `cloud_essd`, `cloud_auto`, `cloud_essd_entry`, `cloud_efficiency`, `cloud_ssd`. |
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `performanceLevel` | string |  | performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0. One of `PL0`, `PL1`, `PL2`, `PL3`. |
| `provisionedIops` | integer (int64) |  | provisionedIops of a cloud_auto disk. Minimum 0. Maximum 50000. |
| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk, e.g. 100Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.storage.localStorage`

localStorage is accepted so that a profile written for a vendor with local disks is not pruned silently, but local disks are not supported on Alibaba Cloud yet (the i and d families are deferred): only the policy ignore is accepted, any other is refused when the object is applied.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.vendors.alicloud.storage.root`

root configures the system disk.

Validation: performanceLevel is only valid for cloud_essd (`!has(self.performanceLevel) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_essd'`).

Validation: provisionedIops and burstingEnabled are only valid for cloud_auto (`(!has(self.provisionedIops) && !has(self.burstingEnabled)) \|\| !has(self.category) \|\| self.category == 'cloud_auto'`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burstingEnabled` | boolean |  | burstingEnabled turns performance bursting on for a cloud_auto disk. |
| `category` | string |  | category is the disk category. Built-in default cloud_essd. One of `cloud_essd`, `cloud_auto`, `cloud_essd_entry`, `cloud_efficiency`, `cloud_ssd`. |
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the disk. Built-in default false: ECS refuses encrypted system disks in some zones (Singapore zone A, Hong Kong zone D), and true takes those zones out of the offerings. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key used for encryption; the account's default service key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `performanceLevel` | string |  | performanceLevel of a cloud_essd disk. Built-in default PL0. One of `PL0`, `PL1`, `PL2`, `PL3`. |
| `provisionedIops` | integer (int64) |  | provisionedIops of a cloud_auto disk. Minimum 0. Maximum 50000. |
| `size` | integer or string |  | size of the disk, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi for the system disk. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws`

aws configures AWS nodes.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `imageOwner` | string |  | imageOwner is the AWS account that owns the Flatcar images. Empty means the official Flatcar account. Pattern `^([0-9]{12})?$`. |
| `instanceProfile` | string |  | instanceProfile is the name of an IAM instance profile attached to the nodes. Empty by default: nodes hold no cloud credentials. At most 128 characters. |
| `metadataOptions` | [object](#specvendorsawsmetadataoptions) |  | metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: IMDSv2 only, hop limit 1. |
| `networking` | [object](#specvendorsawsnetworking) |  | networking overrides the generic spec.networking for AWS. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions is the allow-list of AWS regions; empty means every active region the driver can use. At most 64 items. |
| `resources` | [object](#specvendorsawsresources) |  | resources says how the AWS resources a node depends on are provided. |
| `storage` | [object](#specvendorsawsstorage) |  | storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (gp3, 64 GiB, encrypted root volume; no extra volumes). |

### `spec.vendors.aws.metadataOptions`

metadataOptions configures the instance metadata service. Built-in default: IMDSv2 only, hop limit 1.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `httpPutResponseHopLimit` | integer (int32) |  | httpPutResponseHopLimit is the IMDS hop limit; 1 keeps the service out of reach of containers. Built-in default 1. Minimum 1. Maximum 64. |
| `httpTokens` | string |  | httpTokens: required allows IMDSv2 only. Built-in default required. One of `required`, `optional`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking`

networking overrides the generic spec.networking for AWS.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specvendorsawsnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound. |
| `isolation` | string |  | isolation overrides spec.networking.isolation. One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean |  | publicIPv4 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv4. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean |  | publicIPv6 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv6. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking.inbound`

inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specvendorsawsnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources`

resources says how the AWS resources a node depends on are provided.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimages) |  | images brings the Flatcar boot images with the one selector of every resource kind (plan 14 A1): explicit AMI IDs per region, a name pattern, tags or native filters. Optional: without it the driver finds the pinned release by name in the owner's account. Whatever the lookup, the image's name or tags must say the pinned channel and version, or the region's images are not ready. Images take use only. |
| `placementGroups` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesplacementgroups) |  | placementGroups nodes are launched into (see the placement profiles). |
| `securityGroups` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcessecuritygroups) |  | securityGroups attached to nodes. |
| `subnets` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcessubnets) |  | subnets nodes are launched into. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.images`

images brings the Flatcar boot images with the one selector of every resource kind (plan 14 A1): explicit AMI IDs per region, a name pattern, tags or native filters. Optional: without it the driver finds the pinned release by name in the owner's account. Whatever the lookup, the image's name or tags must say the pinned channel and version, or the region's images are not ready. Images take use only.

Validation: images accepts use only: it has no create and no forbid (`has(self.use) && !has(self.create) && !(has(self.forbid) && self.forbid)`).

Validation: images cannot use select all: a launch needs one image (`!has(self.use) \|\| !has(self.use.select) \|\| self.use.select != 'all'`).

Validation: at most one of use, create and forbid may be set (`(has(self.use) ? 1 : 0) + (has(self.create) ? 1 : 0) + ((has(self.forbid) && self.forbid) ? 1 : 0) <= 1`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagescreate) |  | create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle. |
| `forbid` | boolean |  | forbid opts the kind out of auto-creation: offerings that need it are unavailable unless the vendor's default resource exists. |
| `use` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagesuse) |  | use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.images.create`

create lets SCarpenter create and own the resource, with a lifecycle.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lifecycle` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagescreatelifecycle) |  | lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3). |
| `timing` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagescreatetiming) |  | timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.images.create.lifecycle`

lifecycle decides when the resource is deleted. Without it the kind's default applies (00a section 9.3).

Validation: ttl is only valid with policy idleTTL (`self.policy == 'idleTTL' \|\| !has(self.ttl)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy is perUse, idleTTL or retain. One of `perUse`, `idleTTL`, `retain`. |
| `ttl` | string |  | ttl is how long an unused resource is kept (policy idleTTL). Default 24h, or the controller's --resource-default-ttl. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.images.create.timing`

timing decides when the resource is created. Default: on demand.

Validation: regions is required with mode preCreate and invalid otherwise (`self.mode == 'preCreate' ? has(self.regions) : !has(self.regions)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `"onDemand"` | mode: onDemand creates the resource when the first launch needs it; preCreate creates it in the listed regions right away and keeps it. One of `onDemand`, `preCreate`. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions are the regions to create the resource in (mode preCreate). At least 1 items. At most 64 items. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.resources.images.use`

use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted.

Validation: set at least one of ids, name, tags, match, filters and expression: an empty use would select every resource (`has(self.ids) \|\| has(self.name) \|\| has(self.tags) \|\| has(self.match) \|\| has(self.filters) \|\| has(self.expression)`).

Validation: orderBy is only valid with select newest or oldest (`!has(self.orderBy) \|\| (has(self.select) && (self.select == 'newest' \|\| self.select == 'oldest'))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string |  | expression is a query in the vendor's own language, where it has one. At most 4096 characters. |
| `filters` | array of [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagesusefilters) |  | filters are the vendor's own filters for the kind, passed through: name is the vendor's filter or parameter name, values are ORed. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. |
| `ids` | map of array values |  | ids lists vendor IDs per region (the vendor's region name). The key "*" applies to every region in scope (a resource that is global at the vendor, the same ID in every region); a region key adds to it. With other fields the IDs are ANDed with them. Rule: ids keys are a region name or * (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 64)`). |
| `match` | [object](#specvendorsawsresourcesimagesusematch) |  | match holds the portable attributes, with one spelling on every vendor. |
| `name` | string |  | name is a glob on the kind's name field: * is any run of characters, ? one character, \ escapes them; exact without wildcards. At most 255 characters. |
| `orderBy` | string |  | orderBy is what newest and oldest order by: created, name or label:&lt;key&gt;. At most 255 characters. Rule: orderBy is created, name or label:<key> (`self == 'created' \|\| self == 'name' \|\| (self.startsWith('label:') && self.size() > 6)`). |
| `select` | string |  | select says how many of the matches are used. Without it the kind's default applies (the driver's capability declaration). One of `exactlyOne`, `all`, `newest`, `oldest`. |
| `tags` | map of string values |  | tags are tags (labels, where the vendor has no tags) that must all be on the resource with the given value; the value "*" means the key exists. Rule: tag keys are 1 to 255 characters and values at most 255 (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 255 && self[k].size() <= 255)`). |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage`

storage overrides the built-in storage defaults (gp3, 64 GiB, encrypted root volume; no extra volumes).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [object](#specvendorsawsstoragedata) |  | data lists extra EBS volumes created with the instance. At most 8 items. |
| `localStorage` | [object](#specvendorsawsstoragelocalstorage) |  | localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them. |
| `root` | [object](#specvendorsawsstorageroot) |  | root configures the root EBS volume. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.data[]`

DataVolume is an extra EBS volume: EBS settings plus the guest side (name, filesystem, mount path).

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `filesystem` | string | `"ext4"` | filesystem the first-boot unit creates on the volume. One of `ext4`, `xfs`, `btrfs`. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption. At most 2048 characters. |
| `mountPath` (required) | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the volume is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | name identifies the volume in the profile and in the device hints rendered into Ignition. At most 40 characters. Pattern `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` (required) | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the volume, e.g. 500Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` (required) | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.localStorage`

localStorage configures the instance store disks of types that have them.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mountPath` | string |  | mountPath is the absolute path the local storage is mounted at. At most 255 characters. Pattern `^/[^\x00]*$`. |
| `policy` (required) | string |  | policy: ignore leaves the disks alone, mount mounts them, raid0 stripes them into one volume and mounts it. One of `ignore`, `mount`, `raid0`. |

### `spec.vendors.aws.storage.root`

root configures the root EBS volume.

Validation: iops is only valid for gp3, io1 and io2 (`!has(self.iops) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType in ['gp3', 'io1', 'io2']`).

Validation: throughput is only valid for gp3 (`!has(self.throughput) \|\| !has(self.volumeType) \|\| self.volumeType == 'gp3'`).

Validation: io1 and io2 need iops (`!has(self.volumeType) \|\| !(self.volumeType in ['io1', 'io2']) \|\| has(self.iops)`).

Validation: kmsKeyID needs encrypted (`!has(self.kmsKeyID) \|\| !has(self.encrypted) \|\| self.encrypted`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encrypted` | boolean |  | encrypted encrypts the volume. Built-in default true. |
| `iops` | integer (int32) |  | iops provisioned for gp3, io1 and io2 volumes. Minimum 100. Maximum 256000. |
| `kmsKeyID` | string |  | kmsKeyID is the KMS key (ID, alias or ARN) used for encryption; the account's default EBS key when empty. At most 2048 characters. |
| `throughput` | integer (int32) |  | throughput in MiB/s provisioned for gp3 volumes. Minimum 125. Maximum 2000. |
| `volumeSize` | integer or string |  | volumeSize of the root volume, e.g. 64Gi. Built-in default 64Gi. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |
| `volumeType` | string |  | volumeType is the EBS volume type. Built-in default gp3. One of `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `st1`, `sc1`, `standard`. |

### `spec.vendors.fake.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

Validation: orderBy is only valid with select newest or oldest (`!has(self.orderBy) \|\| (has(self.select) && (self.select == 'newest' \|\| self.select == 'oldest'))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expression` | string |  | expression is a query in the vendor's own language, where it has one. At most 4096 characters. |
| `filters` | array of [object](#specvendorsfakeresourcesnetworksusefilters) |  | filters are the vendor's own filters for the kind, passed through: name is the vendor's filter or parameter name, values are ORed. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. |
| `ids` | map of array values |  | ids lists vendor IDs per region (the vendor's region name). The key "*" applies to every region in scope (a resource that is global at the vendor, the same ID in every region); a region key adds to it. With other fields the IDs are ANDed with them. Rule: ids keys are a region name or * (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 64)`). |
| `match` | [object](#specvendorsfakeresourcesnetworksusematch) |  | match holds the portable attributes, with one spelling on every vendor. |
| `name` | string |  | name is a glob on the kind's name field: * is any run of characters, ? one character, \ escapes them; exact without wildcards. At most 255 characters. |
| `orderBy` | string |  | orderBy is what newest and oldest order by: created, name or label:&lt;key&gt;. At most 255 characters. Rule: orderBy is created, name or label:<key> (`self == 'created' \|\| self == 'name' \|\| (self.startsWith('label:') && self.size() > 6)`). |
| `select` | string |  | select says how many of the matches are used. Without it the kind's default applies (the driver's capability declaration). One of `exactlyOne`, `all`, `newest`, `oldest`. |
| `tags` | map of string values |  | tags are tags (labels, where the vendor has no tags) that must all be on the resource with the given value; the value "*" means the key exists. Rule: tag keys are 1 to 255 characters and values at most 255 (`self.all(k, k.size() > 0 && k.size() <= 255 && self[k].size() <= 255)`). |

| `size` (required) | integer or string |  | size of the disk. Pattern `^(\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))(([KMGTPE]i)\|[numkMGTPE]\|([eE](\+\|-)?(([0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)\|(\.[0-9]+))))?$`. |

### `spec.vendors.hcloud`

hcloud configures Hetzner Cloud nodes.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `networking` | [object](#specvendorshcloudnetworking) |  | networking overrides the generic spec.networking for Hetzner. A server needs a public IPv4 or IPv6 address (publicIPv4 defaults to true, publicIPv6 to false); inbound rules become the rules of the firewall SCarpenter creates. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions is the allow-list of Hetzner locations (fsn1, nbg1, hel1, ash, hil, sin); empty means every location of the project. At most 16 items. |
| `resources` | [object](#specvendorshcloudresources) |  | resources says how the Hetzner resources a node depends on are provided. |
| `sshKey` | string |  | sshKey is the name or ID of an SSH key of the project that is injected into the nodes. Optional, default none: nodes are configured by Ignition and need no key. At most 255 characters. |
| `storage` | [object](#specvendorshcloudstorage) |  | storage adds data volumes. The root disk belongs to the server type and cannot be configured. |

### `spec.vendors.hcloud.networking`

networking overrides the generic spec.networking for Hetzner. A server needs a public IPv4 or IPv6 address (publicIPv4 defaults to true, publicIPv6 to false); inbound rules become the rules of the firewall SCarpenter creates.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inbound` | [object](#specvendorshcloudnetworkinginbound) |  | inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound. |
| `isolation` | string |  | isolation overrides spec.networking.isolation. One of `none`, `nodeclass`, `run`. |
| `publicIPv4` | boolean |  | publicIPv4 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv4. |
| `publicIPv6` | boolean |  | publicIPv6 overrides spec.networking.publicIPv6. |

### `spec.vendors.hcloud.networking.inbound`

inbound replaces spec.networking.inbound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rules` | array of [object](#specvendorshcloudnetworkinginboundrules) |  | rules allow traffic from CIDRs; everything else is denied. At most 32 items. |

### `spec.vendors.hcloud.networking.inbound.rules[]`

InboundRule allows inbound traffic from CIDRs.

Validation: ports are only valid for tcp and udp (`!has(self.fromPort) \|\| self.protocol == 'tcp' \|\| self.protocol == 'udp'`).

Validation: toPort needs fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| has(self.fromPort)`).

Validation: toPort must not be smaller than fromPort (`!has(self.toPort) \|\| self.toPort >= self.fromPort`).

Validation: cidrs must be valid CIDR notation (`self.cidrs.all(c, isCIDR(c))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cidrs` (required) | array of string |  | cidrs are the allowed source networks. At least 1 items. At most 32 items. At most 43 characters. |
| `fromPort` | integer (int32) |  | fromPort is the first port of the range (tcp and udp); without ports the rule covers every port. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |
| `protocol` (required) | string |  | protocol of the rule. One of `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `any`. |
| `toPort` | integer (int32) |  | toPort is the last port of the range; defaults to fromPort. Minimum 1. Maximum 65535. |

| `images` | [object](#specvendorshcloudresourcesimages) |  | images brings the Flatcar snapshots with the one selector of every resource kind (plan 14 A1). Optional: without it the driver finds the snapshots of the pinned release by their labels (os=flatcar, flatcar-channel and flatcar-version). Snapshots are global in the project, so IDs go under the key "*". Images take use only. |

### `spec.vendors.hcloud.resources.images`

Optional: without it the driver finds the snapshots of the pinned release by their labels (os=flatcar, flatcar-channel and flatcar-version). | `use` | [object](#specvendorshcloudresourcesimagesuse) |  | use brings an existing resource: it is validated per region, never modified and never deleted. |
